# Blank-page fixtures

`rome-flyleaf-p0000{2,3,4}-{150,360}dpi.png` are the three intentionally blank
gray flyleaves from pages 2–4 of `History of Ancient Rome_2005 raw.pdf`,
rasterized by Poppler at the cleanup preview DPI (150) and the source/final DPI
(360).

The pairs preserve a production regression where illumination normalization
turned harmless low-contrast paper texture into unrelated black patterns. The
pattern differed by resolution, so preview and final output disagreed. Both
resolutions of every page must resolve to a clean white B&W page from the
raw-source blank-page evidence.
